idea-plugin.name: DeepSeek Harness WebUI
idea-plugin.description:
Docks the DeepSeek Harness Web UI into an IDE tool window, rendered by the IDE's bundled Chromium (JCEF). The whole agent interface — reasoning streams, tool-call trajectory, sessions, permission/preset switching — lives inside the IDE, hideable like the terminal.

How to use

  1. Start the DeepSeek Harness Web UI in a terminal: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web (served at http://127.0.0.1:3080 by default).
  2. Open the DeepSeek Harness tool window on the right edge of the IDE — the Web UI loads inside it.
  3. Whenever you restart or rebuild the dsh server, click the reload button in the tool-window header (or gear menu → Reload Page) to refresh instantly — no IDE restart needed.

Features

  • DeepSeek Harness Web UI docked as a standard IDE tool window
  • DeepSeek Chat (chat.deepseek.com) pinned as a permanent tab next to the WebUI
  • Reload the active tab without restarting the IDE (hard reload, browser cache bypassed)
  • Theme-aware tool window icon (light/dark)

Homepage: github.com/Chocomintopia/dsh-jetbrains-plugin
